title: GMV
question: 今年每个月的 GMV
sql:
SELECT
  SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7)
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 1000
